QUESTION: What was the NASDAQ Official Closing Price (NOCP) of Nvidia (NVDA) on July 31, 2026?

SETTLEMENT RULES:
1. You are an AI judge settling an information market. Determine the correct outcome using the data provided at the time of settlement.
2. Use the NASDAQ Official Closing Price (NOCP) for NVDA on July 31, 2026, as displayed on the NASDAQ Historical NOCP page. Do not use pre-market, after-hours, or intraday prices.
3. Use the exact value shown by NASDAQ without any additional rounding or modification.
4. Compare that value directly against the four outcome boundaries defined below. Every range is inclusive of its lower bound and exclusive of its upper bound:
   - "$198.77 or above" — close price greater than or equal to $198.77
   - "Between $193.92 and $198.77" — close price greater than or equal to $193.92 AND strictly less than $198.77
   - "Between $189.07 and $193.92" — close price greater than or equal to $189.07 AND strictly less than $193.92
   - "Below $189.07" — close price strictly less than $189.07
5. Give your final answer as exactly one of the four outcome labels.

DATA SOURCES: NASDAQ NVDA Historical NOCP (https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/nvda/historical-nocp)

POSSIBLE OUTCOMES — select one outcome exactly and output NOTHING else:
$198.77 or above
Between $193.92 and $198.77
Between $189.07 and $193.92
Below $189.07
